about: Human plasma fibrin gel (fibrinogen 2.7 g/L), quasi-static tension. Every value is labelled by its source; a value marked placeholder or derived is not a measurement.

labels.young_modulus: read: Tutwiler et al. 2021, Acta Biomater. 131:355, Table II, network modulus Y_max of the uncracked gel (5.7 +- 0.2 kPa), used as a small-strain Young's modulus (an approximation)
labels.poisson_ratio: placeholder (the gel loses volume in tension; no value read)
labels.toughness: read: Tutwiler et al. 2020, Sci. Adv. 6:eabc0496, Gc = 7.6 +- 0.45 J/m^2, edge-notch tension
labels.length_scale: derived: AT2 l = 27 E Gc / (256 sigma_c^2) = 0.27 mm with sigma_c = 4.1 kPa (read: Tutwiler et al. 2021, Table I, uncracked critical stress), rounded to 0.3 mm
labels.stretch_limit: read: Tutwiler et al. 2020, stretch 2.8 (log strain 1.04) 100 um ahead of the tip at fracture; used only by the local-softening control
labels.residual_stiffness: numerical: the fully damaged material's share of stiffness

model: decoupled compressible neo-Hookean; the paper's fibre law is not used (its parameters are not stated in the text read)
